description: Angular component for a JSON content editor with syntax highlighting, validation, and formatting features, used within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: JsonContentComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing a JSON editor with syntax highlighting, validation, and formatting.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the Ace editor with appropriate settings and event handlers.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates placeholder text in the editor when empty.

methods.name: updateEditorPlaceholder
methods.description: Updates or removes the placeholder based on editor content.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for the Ace editor.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially contentType.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for propagating changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for touch events (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets the disabled state of the editor.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the content, returning validation errors if any.

methods.name: validateOnSubmit
methods.description: Performs validation and propagates change on form submission.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal content state from editor and triggers validation.

methods.name: onFullscreen
methods.description: Resizes the editor for fullscreen mode.
